tagline: Building trust, one project at a time
business_description: A family-owned general contractor specializing in residential remodels, custom home builds, and commercial tenant improvements across the region.
preferred_colors: Deep navy and a warm amber, with clean off-white backgrounds
preferred_fonts: Something classic and dependable, not trendy
content_owner: Client provides project descriptions; designer polishes copy
media_owner: Client has a strong library of jobsite and finished-project photos
design_style: Professional, grounded, trustworthy — solid and established, not flashy
avoid: No neon colors, no overly modern or playful styling
reference_why: Their site feels solid and credible — big project photos, a clear phone number up top, and obvious calls to action.

business_description: A neighborhood specialty coffee shop and bakery focused on locally roasted beans, fresh pastries, and a cozy place to gather.
preferred_colors: Warm terracotta, soft cream, a little sage green
preferred_fonts: Friendly and inviting, a little hand-crafted feel
content_owner: Designer writes the copy from the owner's notes
media_owner: Owner shares phone photos; designer may source a few stock images
avoid: Nothing corporate, cold, or high-tech feeling
reference_why: It feels warm and personal — lots of photos of the space and the food, and it makes you want to visit.
